verdict.rationale: Gitea's own docs say submitters can receive review comments and 'respond or modify code online', and that review runs through the Pull Request/AGit workflow with online code browsing. This directly targets the story, but it is a single brief claim with no detail on how the in-browser editor commits to the PR branch. Missing for 10: documentation of the web file editor and how its commits land on the reviewed PR branch, explicit confirmation of committing (not just commenting) from the browser, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
